title: A mid-session script switch has no transliteration layer to cross
why_real: Indian dictation flips scripts mid-session; the memory was taught in Latin script (Priyaa/priya) but this utterance arrives in Devanagari, and the system has no transliteration layer, so it correctly does nothing instead of guessing.

expected.reason: no_memory: the Devanagari surface never normalizes to a Latin form the store holds
